description: This file defines the URL class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and handling functionalities, including nested KeyValue class for key-value pair management.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL with parsing, validation, and encoding functionalities, supporting different schemes and URL components.

classes.name: URL::KeyValue
classes.description: Handles key-value pairs within URL query strings, providing methods to access and interpret key data.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Returns the full URL as a string.

methods.name: URL::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the URL has a valid scheme.

methods.name: URL::Clear
methods.description: Resets the URL components to default/unknown state.

methods.name: URL::Type
methods.description: Returns the scheme type of the URL.

methods.name: URL::UserName
methods.description: Returns the username component of the URL.

methods.name: URL::Password
methods.description: Returns the password component of the URL.

methods.name: URL::Host
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URL.

methods.name: URL::Port
methods.description: Returns the port number of the URL.

methods.name: URL::Path
methods.description: Returns the path component of the URL.

methods.name: URL::Query
methods.description: Returns the query string of the URL.

methods.name: URL::Ref
methods.description: Returns the reference fragment of the URL.
